name: NinjaDraw – Diagram, Flowchart, Mind Map & Sketching Tool
author: Yalogica

sections.description:
🏆 The Best Flowcharts, Diagrams and Mind Maps Builder for WordPress

Create flowcharts, diagrams, wireframes, and sketches with NinjaDraw, a hand-drawn style editor based on Excalidraw. Designed for bloggers, developers, and marketers, this tool allows for easy visual content creation. Perfect for educational blogs, business dashboards, project planning, UX/UI wireframing, and creative storytelling.

Whether you’re a blogger, educator, marketer, or developer, NinjaDraw empowers you to design diagrams directly in WordPress – no coding or design skills needed! Seamlessly integrate flowcharts, brainstorming boards, process maps, and custom illustrations into your posts, pages, or sidebars.

🔥 NINJADRAW PRO

🚀 Optimized WordPress Performance & Page Speed

Note: NinjaDraw is built with website speed and Core Web Vitals in mind. In the WordPress admin, the heavy editor engine loads only when needed using smart lazy loading. On the frontend, your site remains lightning-fast because it only displays optimized, lightweight SVG files without heavy external scripts, layout shifts, or bulky base64 data.

🎯 Key Features

  • Excalidraw Editor Integration – intuitive hand-drawn style drawing tool.
  • Lightweight SVG Output – optimized vector files for SEO and fast loading.
  • WordPress Media Library Integration – seamless image management inside the canvas.
  • User-Friendly Interface – create diagrams in seconds with zero learning curve.
  • Custom Styling & Branding – choose colors, fonts, and line styles to match your site.
  • Responsive Layouts – diagrams, flowcharts, and sketches look sharp on desktops, tablets, and mobile.
  • Save & Reuse Templates – store your canvas drawings and reuse diagrams across your site.
  • 100% GDPR-Compliant – no data tracking or external servers, your sketches stay private.
  • Shortcode & Gutenberg Support – embed diagrams anywhere using core Gutenberg blocks or shortcodes.

NinjaDraw Free – General Features
⚡ Number of diagrams – maximum 5 diagrams
✅ Vector Elements – rectangle, diamond, ellipse, arrow, line, text
✅ Image Canvas Support – insert images from WordPress Media Library
✅ Smart Undo/Redo History – full history stack to undo/redo changes safely

NinjaDraw Pro includes everything from Free, plus:
✅✨ Unlimited Diagrams – for enterprise-scale websites and large documentation
✅✨ Open & Edit Native Files: import and edit .excalidraw files directly
✅✨ Frame tool – group and organize elements into clean layout frames
✅✨ Layout Frame Tool – group, section, and organize elements into clean mockup frames
✅✨ Interactive Web Embeds – easily embed external interactive web content into diagrams
✅✨ Laser Pointer Tool – highlight elements in real-time during live presentations
✅✨ Mermaid Import – instantly convert text scripts and code into flowcharts

✨ How to Create Diagrams & Mind Maps in WordPress

Harness the power of Excalidraw’s intuitive tools directly in your WordPress editor dashboard. Create professional mind maps, process charts, flowcharts, and UI wireframes with drag-and-drop simplicity.

✨ Why Choose NinjaDraw Whiteboard?

  • Universal Builder Integration: Works flawlessly with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, and all major themes.
  • Vector Export Options: Save diagrams as PNG/SVG for sharing, backup, or offline use.
  • Privacy First Framework: GDPR-compliant – no third-party tracking cookies or data collection.

🚀 Compatibility

Not all themes and plugins are built the same way, so NinjaDraw is designed with extra compatibility in mind.​ NinjaDraw works seamlessly with modern WordPress themes and popular page builders that support standard blocks and shortcodes.

PAGE BUILDERS
* Gutenberg – modern built-in WordPress block editor
* Classic Editor – classic built-in WordPress editor
* Elementor – leading website builder platform on WordPress
* WP Bakery – create any layout with intuitive way
* Beaver – page builder you can trust with your business
* Bricks – amazing block editor with many templates
* Brizy – next-gen website builder that anyone can use
* and more…

💼 GDPR & Privacy

  • We do not collect or store any information about our visitors or users without their consent.
  • We also do not transfer any data to external servers without users’ consent.

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “NinjaDraw”.
  3. Click Install Now and activate the plugin.
  4. Use the Gutenberg block or shortcode [ninjadraw id="123"] to embed diagrams!
sections.faq:
Can I use NinjaDraw with Elementor?

Yes! NinjaDraw works seamlessly with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder, and all major page builders via shortcodes or native blocks.

Are flowcharts and diagrams responsive on mobile?

Absolutely! Your diagrams adapt flawlessly to all screen sizes and mobile device layouts.

Where is the developer version hosted?

The open-source developer version is available on GitHub.

Is the NinjaDraw editor GDPR compliant?

Yes! We don’t collect, store, or track user data and drawings without consent. Everything stays on your server.

1.3.0

  • Added: Insert images from WordPress Media Library directly into diagrams via the image tool
  • Changed: Migrated editor to ESM with lazy loading for faster page load
  • Fixed: Fixed unstyled content flash on editor page

1.2.2

  • Changed: Compatibility with WP 7.0

1.2.1

  • Changed: Upgrade admin notice on the plugin pages (dismissible for 30 days)
  • Fixed: Compatibility with PHP 7.4

1.2.0

  • Fixed: Switched from ES module to UMD build to prevent global variable duplication errors in WordPress environment
  • Changed: Compatibility with WP 6.9

1.1.0

  • Added: Brand new redesigned version

1.0.0
